commands.lint: go vet ./... && unformatted="$(gofmt -l .)" && { [ -z "$unformatted" ] || { echo "gofmt needed: $unformatted"; exit 1; }; } && go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@v0.8.2 ./...
commands.publish_dry_run: go mod tidy -diff && go mod verify && go list -m
commands.publish: echo 'Go modules publish by tag: pushing the mirror tagged v'"$(sed -n 's/^const Version = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' version.go)"' is the release; proxy.golang.org fetches it on first request.'
